sources.entry: Zim - Graphical text editor used to maintain a collection of wiki pages. Each page can contain links to other pages, simple formatting and images. (Source Code) GPL-2.0 Python/deb

summary.one_liner: Zim is a graphical desktop wiki editor that stores wiki pages as plain text files with wiki formatting, written in Python with GTK.
summary.what_it_does: Zim is a graphical text editor for maintaining a collection of wiki pages. Each page can link to other pages, use simple formatting, and include images. Pages are organized in a folder structure like an outliner and can have attachments. Linking to a nonexistent page creates it. All data is stored in plain text files using wiki markup. Plugins add features such as a task list manager, an equation editor, a tray icon, and version control support.
use_cases: Maintain a daily or weekly journal
Take notes during meetings or lectures
how_to_run: Install from a package: apt install zim (Debian/Ubuntu)
notable: Plain text file storage with wiki formatting, so notes remain readable outside the app
Creating a page is as simple as linking to a nonexistent page
Hierarchical page folders with attachments, similar to an outliner
Plugin system for task lists, equation editing, tray icon, and version control
Runs directly from the source directory without installation
caveats: macOS install is via third-party package managers (Homebrew or MacPorts), and the maintainers say they cannot offer support for it
Windows setup requires MSYS2 with GTK3 and Python packages
Most plugins have additional requirements listed in their own descriptions
